# Icons8

> Icons8 is a comprehensive platform for free and premium design assets including icons, illustrations, photos, music, and AI-powered creative tools.

Icons8 provides over 1.5 million free icons in multiple styles (SVG, PNG), along with vector illustrations, royalty-free music through Fugue, and integrated design software like Lunacy and Mega Creator. The platform offers native apps and plugins for popular design tools including Figma, Google Docs, Webflow, and Miro, making assets accessible across the entire design workflow.

## Key Topics

- Icons (SVG, PNG)
- Illustrations (Vector, 3D, Animated)
- Royalty-Free Music (Fugue)
- Lunacy (Design Software)
- Icon Packs (Fluency, Glyph Neue, iOS Glyphs, Line Awesome)
- AI Tools (Illustration Generator, Face Swapper, Background Remover)
- Design Assets
- Animated Icons & Illustrations
- Desktop Apps (Pichon)
- Figma Integration
- Social Media Design (Mega Creator)
- Icon Editor (Iconizer)
- Cross-Platform Support

## Core Design Assets

- [Free Icons, Clipart Illustrations, Photos, and Music](https://icons8.com): Icons8 homepage: free design assets including icons, photos, illustrations, music
- [Download 1,495,100 free icons (SVG, PNG)](https://icons8.com/icons): Icons8 main icon library with 1.5M+ free SVG and PNG icons
- [Free Illustrations - Vector SVG and PNG Graphics, Ouch Clipart Images](https://icons8.com/illustrations): Ouch: free vector, 3D, and animated illustrations in SVG and PNG
- [Free Royalty-Free Music — Fugue](https://icons8.com/music): Fugue: free royalty-free music library for videos, movies, and websites

## Design Software & Tools

- [Lunacy - Free Graphic Design Software for Desktop](https://icons8.com/lunacy): Lunacy: free cross-platform graphic design software with built-in assets
- [Craft stunning social media visuals using ready-to-use templates](https://icons8.com/mega-creator): Mega Creator: social media design tool with ready-made templates
- [AI Illustration Generator - Free Online Art Maker](https://icons8.com/illustration-generator): AI Illustration Generator: create consistent vector illustrations with AI
- [Free icon tools](https://icons8.com/iconizer): Iconizer: free online icon editor for customizing and editing icons

- [Windows 11 Color Icons – Download free PNG, SVG icons](https://icons8.com/icons/fluency): Windows 11 Fluency colorful icon pack for applications and design
- [Glyph Neue Icons – Download free PNG, SVG icons](https://icons8.com/icons/glyph-neue): Glyph Neue: monochrome detailed icon pack in PNG and SVG formats
- [iOS 17 Glyph Icons – Download free PNG, SVG icons](https://icons8.com/icons/ios-glyphs): iOS 17 monochrome glyph icons designed for Apple applications
- [Line Awesome — Free Beautiful Icon Font](https://icons8.com/line-awesome): Line Awesome: free icon font replacing Font Awesome with modern line icons
- [emoji](https://icons8.com/icon/set/emoji/emoji): Emoji icon pack with Unicode-compliant editable emoji graphics
